professional_summary: Secondary mathematics teacher and school leader with over twenty years of classroom, curriculum and staff development experience across twelve schools.

responsibilities: Taught mathematics to grades 6 to 9 across 3 sections
Planned schemes of work aligned with the national curriculum
Designed and moderated term and annual assessments
Ran weekly remedial sessions for students below the expected level
Met parents each term to review progress and set learning targets
achievements: Raised the pass rate in secondary mathematics by 5 percentage points
Mentored 2 newly qualified teachers through their first year
